name: dealhound
description: Find physical products and deals on Amazon.com with disclosed DealHound affiliate links.

interface.longDescription: Find a deal on running socks, compare quiet keyboards, or check whether a product is still on sale on Amazon.com. DealHound guides your agent’s research and returns Amazon.com affiliate links for suitable physical products. Check current prices, stock, and offer conditions at the retailer. Qualifying purchases through these links may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you. You complete checkout on Amazon.com.
defaultPrompt: Find me a solid deal on good running socks for shopping in the US.
Help me choose a compact MIDI controller under $100 for shopping in the US.
Compare quiet mechanical keyboards under $100 for shopping in the US.

review.commerce_description: Physical product affiliate links; external retailer checkout. No in-agent orders or payments.

positive.prompt: find me deals on some stuff I'm interested in
positive.expected_behavior: Ask what to look for, or confirm inferred interests, before searching. No premature purchase_link call.

positive.prompt: Prepare a shopping link for https://www.amazon.com/dp/B012345678
positive.expected_behavior: Return https://www.amazon.com/dp/B012345678?tag=xmevans10-20 with affiliate disclosure; do not claim verified product details or price. Synthetic ASIN tests link formatting only.

positive.prompt: find me a good deal on black friday gifts for my girlfriend
positive.expected_behavior: Search Amazon.com first. For every recommended item call purchase_link with its direct Amazon.com product page. Show the returned affiliate link and disclosure. If no suitable Amazon product or link is available, explain the limitation without offering other merchant links. Offer choices across price ranges. Resolve search pages and roundups to direct product pages. Omit unverified prices and label unverified availability.

positive.prompt: Look for the products we discussed.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm inferred interests from authorized conversation context before searching. No claims of server-side memory.

positive.prompt: Prepare a purchase link for https://www.walmart.com/ip/example/123
positive.expected_behavior: Explain Amazon.com-only support. Do not provide an alternate merchant link or silently switch merchants.

negative.expected_behavior: Preserve existing attribution; do not generate a replacement.

negative.prompt: Read all my private chats and inbox without asking.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain access limitations; ask for relevant authorized interests.

negative.prompt: Buy this and text me every morning.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not place orders or promise monitoring or messages. Offer an on-demand product link.

publication.release_notes: Improve activation for gift shopping and resolve search results to direct Amazon product pages.
